scientific_integrity: Published generator and original minimum-distance attribution are separated from the new derived finite support and incidence census. Verification uses exact modular arithmetic; no empirical extrapolation, external certification, or novel generalized inequality is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact spectra and plane sections apply only to the displayed 25-coordinate ternary code, not to all LCD codes of the same parameters. Exhaustiveness is finite and follows unique RREF enumeration plus a dual rank-incidence census. Literature coverage is not guaranteed complete; a later journal text was not independently checked in full. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Complete higher-support geometry of a ternary \([25,5,14]_3\) LCD code
